raw_comment:
I noticed that a high percentage of the country had a dry year compared to past years. I also noticed that there are some areas where it was scorched for some reason. 
I wonder what made the difference this year that everything was so dry. I also wonder what that chart looked like 50 years ago. 
This relates to my community because my community heavily relies on farming, and without rain the crops don’t grow to the standards that the farmers need them to.
“Don’t doubt the drought, dryness starts to scorch the U.S.”
